article.title: Mass protests topples Spanish government, new election called
article.author: Editor
article.content: Faced with thousands on the streets Premier Sanchez’s attempt to placate widespread unrest over the housing crisis were sunk by a right-wing coalition. As John Rees explains, the political balance in Spain is at a critical stage. The post Mass protests topples Spanish government, new election called appeared first on MR Online .
